name: Review Discord Community Applications with AI

parameters.content:
AI-powered Discord Community Application Review

Overview

This workflow automatically reviews Discord community applications submitted through a Tally form using AI.

After a submission is received, the workflow validates the required fields and sends the application to an OpenAI model for evaluation. The AI classifies each submission into one of three categories:

・Approved
・Needs Review
・Rejected

Each result includes:

・Decision
・Reason
・Confidence Score
・Risk Level
・AI-generated Summary

Depending on the decision, the application is automatically sent to the appropriate Discord channel. Every processed application is also stored in Google Sheets for future reference and auditing.

Requirements

・Tally Forms
・OpenAI API
・Discord Bot
・Google Sheets

Setup

・Connect your Tally credential.
・Connect your OpenAI credential.
・Connect your Discord Bot.
・Connect Google Sheets.
・Update the IDs inside the Set Fields node.
・Activate the workflow.

Customization

You can easily modify:

・Review criteria
・AI prompts
・Discord channels
・Google Sheets columns
・Approval conditions

Who is this template for?

This template is designed for communities and organizations that receive membership applications and want to reduce manual review work.

Typical use cases include:

・Discord communities
・Gaming servers
・Student organizations
・Online communities
・Beta tester recruitment
・Event registration
・Volunteer applications

Instead of manually reviewing every application, AI performs the first screening and routes each submission to the appropriate review channel.

Step 1
Receive Form Submission

The workflow starts when a user submits the Tally application form.

Step 2
Extract Required Fields

This node organizes all submitted form data into a consistent structure so that the following nodes can easily access the applicant information.

Step 5
Decision Routing

Routes the application according to the AI decision.

Possible outputs:

・Approved
・Needs Review
・Rejected
・Unknown/Error

Step 4
AI Application Review

The application is analyzed using OpenAI.

The AI returns:

・Status
・Summary
・Reason
・Confidence
・Risk Level

Step 3
Validate Required Information

Checks whether required fields such as name, email address and application content are present.

If required information is missing, the workflow immediately sends an error notification.

Step 6
Discord Notification

Sends the review result to the corresponding Discord channel.

Each message includes:

・Applicant
・AI Summary
・Review Reason
・Confidence Score
・Risk Level

Step 7
Save Review Log

Stores every processed application inside Google Sheets.

This creates a searchable review history and supports future audits.

Error Handling

Applications with missing information or unexpected AI responses are redirected to a dedicated Discord error channel for manual review.

This prevents invalid applications from entering the normal review process.

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You are an AI that reviews applications to join a Discord community.

Follow these rules exactly.

Review Criteria

Approved
- The applicant's name is provided.
- A valid email address is provided.
- The comment contains at least one character.

Needs Review
- The name, email address, or comment is missing.
- The application is too ambiguous to evaluate confidently.

Rejected
- The email address format is clearly invalid.
- The application is spam.
- The application contains abusive, offensive, or disruptive content.
- The application is only advertising or promotional content.

Output Rules

Return a JSON object with the following fields:

{
  "status": "",
  "reason": "",
  "confidence": 0,
  "risk": "",
  "summary": ""
}

Requirements:
- status must be one of: "Approved", "Needs Review", or "Rejected".
- reason must be a concise explanation in Japanese.
- confidence must be an integer from 0 to 100.
- risk must be one of: "low", "medium", or "high".
- summary must be written in Japanese, be no longer than 40 characters, and must not include the applicant's name or email address.
- Do not infer or invent information that is not explicitly provided in the application.
- Return only the JSON object. Do not include any additional text or markdown.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Return only ONE of the following values:  Approved - Name, email address, and application content are all provided.  Needs Review - One or more of the following fields are missing:   - Name   - Email address   - Application content  Rejected - The email address format is clearly invalid. - The submission contains spam. - The submission is meaningless, abusive, or unrelated.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Explain the reason for the review result in one concise Japanese sentence.

attributes.name: confidence
attributes.description: Return the confidence level of the review result as an integer between 0 and 100.  100 indicates very high confidence. 0 indicates that the result cannot be determined.

attributes.name: risk
attributes.description: Return exactly ONE of the following risk levels:  low - No issues detected.  medium - The submission contains insufficient information or ambiguous content.  high - The submission contains spam, advertising, abusive language, disruptive content, or clearly fraudulent information.

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: Summarize the application in Japanese within 40 characters.  Do not include the applicant's name or email address in the summary.
